comments:
On the dates ca. 1040 to 1120, see [HCLRANG3]. This conflicts with a mention, in the Chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston, of Gro lung pa being considered for serving as abbot after rNam par ba (ID:6147), i.e. in 1151 ([7FZ3B926]: 111). It also makes it difficult that he was a teacher of Phywa pa (ID:3831), which would have been when Phywa pa was 11 years of age or younger.

In view of the epithet "gro lung pa," he possibly hailed from La stod gro lung (ID:7412) or Gro bo lung (ID:7411).
